title: Replace all Babulus studio-web players with VideoML standard player
description: After TransportControls and player-with-transport exist in VideoML Player: replace every player in Babulus apps/studio-web that currently has transport controls (e.g. PreviewPlayer and its usages in PreviewEmbed, DocsPreviewPlayer, video-editor, studio-workspace) with the standard VideoML player so Babulus consumes the core library instead of its own control bar. Depends on vmlp-hgy.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter
